limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses SCC cell lines (SCC12, A431) and may not generalize to all carcinoma types.
In vivo relevance is supported by clinical sample analysis but not directly tested in animal models.
The role of fibronectin and tenascin-C deposition was ruled out, but other matrix components may contribute.
Off-target effects of pharmacological inhibitors (e.g., Y27632) cannot be completely excluded.
The requirement for Cdc42/MRCK was shown only in SCC cells; other carcinoma cells may use different pathways.
